title: Carried over from the round-2 review and still unaddressed: the fixture-matrix …
description:
Carried over from the round-2 review and still unaddressed: the fixture-matrix test uses non-null assertions (rule!.test(command!)) right after expect(...).toBeDefined(). A narrowing guard (if (!rule) throw new Error(`no such rule ${ruleName}`)) would carry the same safety without the ! escape hatch and would fail with a clearer message on a malformed fixture row.
